create_smoothedvalue: create a SmoothedValue instance to track running median and global average of training metrics
build_metriclogger: build a MetricLogger to log and print training metrics like loss and accuracy during iteration
init_distributed_mode: initialize PyTorch distributed training mode from environment variables or SLURM config
generate_cosine_schedule: generate a cosine annealing learning rate schedule with optional linear warmup phase
save_and_resume_model: save model checkpoints or auto-resume training from the latest checkpoint in output directory
